mainEntity.name: Why does investment-option analysis matter in a investor visa matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The practical point is that work and business routes depend on the real activity in Brazil, the structure around it, and documents that match the proposed purpose closely. In real cases, investment-option analysis changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
